interpretation_limits: Arrival errors are computed in the manually aligned map/odometry frame, without independent ground truth.
Accepted initial_pose only means fresh odometry and measured standstill; it does not certify localization accuracy.
Manual initial_pose changes must not be reported as odometry drift.
Live obstacle logs lack triggering point, point cloud, distance and extrinsics residual; cannot decide actual obstacle versus false positive.
Both latest obstacle stops occurred just after turning at measured linear speeds below the standstill threshold; 0.5 m/s cannot be established as the cause.
Later success after initial_pose adjustments is not proof that prior obstacle stops were false.
The old-map drive run ended with shutdown and RViz SIGINT/SIGTERM; the log cannot identify who initiated it.
STOPPED means zero command requested; physical standstill is separately observed in later approximately 0.5-second samples.

code_evidence.meaning: Initial pose uses manually supplied pose and raw odometry to establish alignment.
Live obstacle height filtering uses configured 0.15 to 1.2 m.
Swept motion check uses max(commanded, measured) speed for stopping horizon.
Any valid obstacle point within radius plus safety margin of sampled trajectory centres triggers Live obstacle.
Absolute per-goal deadline triggers Goal time limit exceeded.
